paragraphs: In Pesikta Rabbati, in the section “of Shabbat and Rosh Chodesh,” 6, Hyman says he was walking with R' A. ben Pedat. But the source is Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3 and the end of Kilayim, and there the reading is Rabbah bar Karya and R' A.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 12:3 has Rabbi bar Kiryya walking with Rabbi Elazar. Hyman’s Rabbah bar Karya form is retained alongside this named form; no identity is merged.

The Shabbat/Rosh Chodesh discourse checked as Pesikta Rabbati 1 has R' Berokya walking with R' Eliezer ben Pedat. The Jerusalem Talmud parallels at Ketubot 12:3 and Kilayim 9:3 have Rabbi bar Kiryya/Barkiryya with Rabbi Elazar. Hyman’s ר״א is retained as R' A., rather than resolving the differing forenames into one identity. His section label and terminal 6 are preserved; they are not substituted with the digital chapter number.
